name: Debt & Loans / Implementation Handoff
texts: Desktop-only design. Preserve the 76px sidebar, topbar, global eye toggle and all other pages. As of 20 Oct 2026: family principal ৳20,000 + laptop principal ৳45,000 = ৳65,000 owed; ৳5,000 receivable. One outgoing payment of ৳7,500 falls in (20 Oct, 19 Nov] inclusive. Incoming receivables are separate.

Use one obligationId for every borrowed loan or financed purchase; schedules reference it, never create a second debt. Derive balances from principal ledger allocations, not independently editable totals. Active, unsettled records feed the overview; only settled records can be archived. Search and tab selection do not change shared totals.

Borrowing increases cash and a liability, not income. Lending moves cash to a receivable, not ordinary expense. Repayment principal reduces liability or receivable; interest and fees are separate classifications. Interest methods must be explicit (flat/simple/amortized), with term basis and rounding rules. Never infer missing terms.

Payment form defaults to tracking only. Production supports source/destination wallets, available-balance validation, confirmation of before/after wallet and loan balances, and exactly one linked transaction. Use atomic writes and idempotency keys; prevent retries or imported matches from duplicating payments. Edit/correction uses reversal ledger entries, not silent history overwrite.

Laptop: ৳60,000 price − ৳15,000 down = ৳45,000 financed; 6 × ৳7,500 from 19 Nov 2026 through 19 Apr 2027. Paid requires a confirmed payment, never date passage. Due Today follows user timezone; Overdue = unpaid due amount before today. Partial amounts only if the plan supports them.

React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Lucide React. Reuse SummaryCard, LoanCard, EMIPlanCard, StatusBadge, PaymentSchedule, PaymentHistory, FormControl and ConfirmationModal. Implement controlled forms, real search/filter/sort, validation, pagination and persistence in application code. Created, edited and payment screens are fixed prototype examples, not a database.

Bind every monetary string to existing Global Privacy modes. Mask ৳••••• everywhere, including forms and confirmations. Masking is not authorization. Reminder options: on due date, 1/3/7 days before, timezone and time. Production needs delivery, cancellation and retry logic. Labels, keyboard order, focus rings, trapped/restored modal focus and live error/success announcements are required.

No mobile or tablet Figma frames added. In code, stack summary cards 2×2 then 1-column, convert schedule rows to labeled cards, stack action buttons, keep filters scrollable within their container, and use a full-height modal/drawer with pinned actions on small screens. No page-level horizontal overflow.

name: Financial Hub / Implementation Handoff
texts: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Lucide React

WalletTotal and WalletMini use existing Wallets variables and wallet IDs. Total is 61,350 across five shared sample wallets, not a separately stored balance. Do not add earmarked occasion funds or debt receivables. Existing pages, auth and global navigation remain unchanged.

ShoppingList {id,name,category,targetDate?,notes?,items[]}. Item {id,name,quantity,estimatedUnitPrice,category?,purchased,actualTotal?,notes?,transactionId?}. Estimate = Σ quantity × unit price; remaining estimate uses unpurchased rows only. Actual is Σ recorded actual totals on purchased rows.

Base groceries: estimate ৳2,500; purchased estimate ৳800; recorded actual ৳795; remaining estimate ৳1,700; under by ৳5 on purchased items. Accessories: ৳5,000 estimate, ৳1,150 actual, 1/4 purchased. Never compare a partial actual total with the entire list estimate as a savings claim. Actual price can be unknown; label it not recorded.

Marking purchased records status and optional actual amount only. No wallet movement or expense is created silently. An explicit record/link flow opens existing Transactions, validates the source wallet and atomically creates or matches one transaction. Deleting a list does not delete financial history.

Prototype uses fixed illustrative BDT-per-unit values: BDT 1; USD 120; EUR 130; GBP 155; INR 1.44; JPY 0.8; CAD 88; AUD 80; SAR 32; AED32.67. Not observed market data. Timestamp 20 Oct 2026 09:00 UTC is a sample. Converted = amount × sourceBDT / targetBDT.

RateProvider {base,rates,asOf,source,status}. Fetch and cache through a server proxy; respect provider licenses. Debounce controlled amount inputs, validate finite nonnegative values, round only for display with currency minor-unit rules, handle same-currency and stale data. Never label sample rates live or promise bank/transfer quotes.

Reuse existing privacyMode and Global Privacy Visible/Hidden modes. All currency symbols, prices, totals, results, exchange-rate amounts and activities are bound and masked, including forms. Never put raw money in hover labels or accessible names while hidden. Privacy masking is not authorization. Use labels, focus rings, keyboard order, modal focus trap/restore and live validation announcements.

Desktop 1440: 76px rail, 32px gutters, tools 820/460 split. Tablet 1024: existing rail retained, 24px gutters, sections stack. Mobile 390: existing collapsed rail and compact topbar, 20px gutters, one column. Card rows replace tables in app. Reuse WalletSummary, WalletMini, ShoppingListCard, ConverterCard, ShortcutCard, ActivityCard, FormControl and ConfirmDialog.

These are fixed sample states, not a working database, calculator service or notification system. Selectors include representative outcomes for every supported currency. Source examples use 100 units; target examples use 12,000 BDT. Shopping item-edit examples are fixed to Bread and purchase examples to Chicken. In code, all actions are record-specific and persist via the application API.

No Financial Reports, PDF/CSV exports or separate reporting/wallet system. Activities are sorted by date and explicitly illustrative; do not fabricate personalized reminders. Production renders only existing shared records with valid destinations. Retain existing component style, subtle hover fill, 2px focus ring and 150ms reduced-motion-aware transitions.
